title: Add invocation-context density maps and delta-cost anchors
author: Leah Kim
description: Problem: teams lacked a compact, time-series friendly view to surface where token-costs concentrate inside multi-turn invocations; alerts based on aggregate per-invocation cost produced high false-positive rates because cost spikes frequently concentrated on a short suffix. This change introduces invocation-context density maps (2D histograms mapping sequence-length bucket to token-position density) and per-invocation delta-cost anchors that mark where incremental token-cost deviates from baseline. Implementation: 1) ingest-level tagging attaches a small anchor tuple (invocation_id, anchor_offset, anchor_cost_delta) for sampled traces; 2) a new background rollup (invocation_density_roller) builds fixed-width 2D histograms and emits compact base64-encoded blobs plus anchor indices for correlation; 3) storage migration adds a new table invocation_density_blobs with tenant_id, route, time_bucket, blob, and anchor_index columns (nullable so older rows do not break); 4) Console additions: a Density Map panel with time-range scrubber, per-model and per-route filtering, and an overlay toggle to surface delta anchors; 5) an API endpoint to fetch raw blob metadata for advanced analysis and CSV export. Operational concerns: sampling is tenant-configurable and defaults to 0.05% for orgs under free tier and 0.2% for enterprise tenants, rollup uses a bounded queue and caps memory to 64MB per worker, and blobs older than 60 days are compacted to a coarse-binned representation. Backwards compatibility: untagged traces are ignored by the new roller and do not affect existing telemetry consumers. Test coverage: unit tests for histogram binning, anchor encoding/decoding, and end-to-end tests that run the roller on synthetic traces. Rollout: feature-flagged per-tenant; start with five internal tenants for 72h, monitor SLO noise and storage IO, then a phased ramp. Docs and runbook: docs/observability/invocation_density_maps.md contains operational guidance, example queries for SLO tuning, and a sample alert recipe for delta-anchor-driven suppression. Merge method: squash.

release_notes: Adds invocation-context density maps (sequence-length vs token-position histograms) and delta-cost anchors for finer token-cost attribution. Includes Console Density Map panel, new storage table for compact blobs, tenant-scoped feature flag, and a compaction/retention plan.
